<section>Chapter 29. "B" Extension for Bit Manipulation, Version 1.0.0 > 29.5. Instructions (in alphabetical order) > 29.5.28. packw > Operation</section>
<previous>#### **Description**

This instruction packs the low 16 bits of _rs1_ and _rs2_ into the 32 least-significant bits of _rd_ , sign extending the 32-bit result to the rest of _rd_ . This instruction only exists on RV64 based systems.</previous>
<target>#### **Operation**

```
let lo_half : bits(16) = X(rs1)[15..0];
let hi_half : bits(16) = X(rs2)[15..0];
X(rd) = EXTS(hi_half @ lo_half);
```</target>
